intro: Section A General Intelligence & Reasoning carries 20 marks in every DSSSB paper. In the 4 official 2023–24 TGT CS papers ({n} questions) the favourites were odd one out (number pairs and letter-cluster codes), mathematical operations (sign replacement and sign interchange), statement–conclusion and course of action, ranking and seating in a row, coded blood relations, shadow-based direction sense, letter series and letter-position tests; most were easy and solvable in under a minute with a fixed method. The notes are method tables with a worked example for every technique; non-verbal figures are described in words.
